node.title: Re: Howto convert Image::Grab jpg object to Image::Magick object???
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
If I understand the [mod://Image::Grab] docs correctly, it just returns the image as binary data. According to [http://www.imagemagick.org/script/perl-magick.php|the docs], [mod://Image::Magick] supports reading filehandles, which you could use with an in-memory filehandle ([doc://open]), as well as reading data in memory directly:

my $image = Image::Magick->new(magick=>'jpg'); open my $fh, '<', \$imgdata or die $!; $image->Read(file=>$fh); # - or - $image->BlobToImage($imgdata);

(untested)
